filter-on-desc: You vari filtering makadhi pa bhodhi iri. baya pano ku gadzirisa sefa.
advanced-filter-description: zvepamusoro sefa allows ku write a string containing following operators: == != <= >= && || ( ) A space iri used as a separator between the Operators. unogona sefa for zvose Custom ndima na typing their names uye values. For Example: Field1 == Value1. Note: If ndima kana values contains spaces, you need ku encapsulate them into single quotes. For Example: 'ndima 1' == 'ukoshi 1'. For single control characters (' \/) ku iva skipped, unogona use \. For example: Field1 == I\'m. Also unogona combine multiple conditions. For Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally zvose operators vari interpreted kubva left ku right. unogona chinja the order na placing brackets. For Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also unogona tsvaga mashoko ndima using regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Paste a Kanboard tumira kunze JSON: an object ne "columns" (kana tasks carrying column_name) uye a "tasks" array (musoro, tsananguro, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, muridzi, tags). Columns become rondedzero uye tasks become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Paste a NextCloud Deck bhodhi JSON (a bhodhi ne "stacks", each stack carrying its "makadhi"). Stacks become rondedzero uye makadhi become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Paste an OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses become rondedzero uye work packages become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Paste a __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become makadhi grouped into vhura / Closed rondedzero.
import-board-instruction-asana: Paste an Asana tasks tumira kunze JSON ({ "data": [...] } kubva the Asana tumira kunze kana GET /tasks). Tasks vari grouped into sections (memberships); zvapedzwa tasks go ku Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Paste a ZenKit rondedzero tumira kunze JSON ({ "musoro", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages become rondedzero uye items become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namira runyorwa rwemabasa emarkdown (tsika inoshandiswa nemidziyo yemarkdown-kanban seObsidian Kanban): misoro ye"## Zita rerunyorwa", ine zvinhu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" pasi payo. Misoro inova runyorwa uye zvinhu zvinova makadhi.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Searches anogona include operators ku refine the tsvaga.  Operators vari specified na writing the operator zita uye ukoshi separated na a colon.  For example, an operator specification ye `list:Blocked` would limit the tsvaga ku makadhi that vari contained mu a rondedzero named *Blocked*.  If the ukoshi contains spaces kana special characters it anofanira iva enclosed mu quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - makadhi mu mabhodhi matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - makadhi mu rondedzero matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - makadhi mu swimlanes matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - makadhi that have a chiratidzo matching *<color>* kana *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - makadhi where *<username>* iri the card's creator
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - makadhi belonging ku a bhodhi assigned ku sangano *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - makadhi belonging ku a bhodhi assigned ku chikwata *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - makadhi which vari due up ku *<n>* mazuva kubva now.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ rondedzero zvose makadhi past their zuva rekupedzisira.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - makadhi which were zvagadzirwa *<n>* mazuva ago kana zvishoma
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - makadhi which were modified *<n>* mazuva ago kana zvishoma
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - where *<status>* iri one ye the following:
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* iri one ye `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kana `__predicate_member__`.  Placing a `-` mu front ye *<field>* searches for the absence ye a ukoshi mu that ndima (e.g. `has:-due` searches for makadhi pasina a zuva rekupedzisira).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* iri one ye `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kana `__predicate_modified__`.  For a descending ronga, place a `-` mu front ye the ronga zita.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - where *<n>* iri a positive integer expressing the number ye makadhi ku iva displayed per peji.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar operators vari *kana*ed together.  makadhi that match chero ye the conditions will iva returned.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` would return makadhi contained mu chero rondedzero named *Blocked* kana *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing operators vari *uye*ed together.  chete makadhi that match zvose ye the differing operators vari returned.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` returns chete makadhi mu the rondedzero *Available* ne a *red* chiratidzo.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: mazuva anogona iva specified as a positive kana negative integer kana using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kana `__predicate_year__` for the yazvino period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: na yakajairwa zvakachengetwa makadhi vari kwete searched.

database-migration-description: Migrate text-based data (everything except attachments uye avatars, which stay pa the filesystem) between MongoDB uye FerretDB v1 (SQLite). The zvimwe database anofanira iva running uye reachable (yakajairwa ports: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; override ne WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). mushure it finishes, point MONGO_URL pa the zvimwe database uye restart WeKan (pa Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kana =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: When WeKan runs inside a Sandstorm grain, its old MongoDB 3 database iri migrated ku FerretDB v1 (SQLite) pa yekutanga launch, uye attachments uye avatars vari zvafambiswa kubva the database ku the grain's mafaira/attachments uye mafaira/avatars directories. This shows whether that migration succeeded uye how much disk space the old raw MongoDB database mafaira still use inside the grain, uye lets you dzima those raw mafaira ku free space.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: mushure a successful migration the data lives mu FerretDB uye pa the filesystem, so the old raw MongoDB 3 database mafaira anogona iva zvadzimwa ku free grain disk space. This haagoni iva undone.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: dzima the raw MongoDB 3 database mafaira ku free disk space? The data has already yave migrated ku FerretDB uye the filesystem. This haagoni iva undone.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Raw MongoDB database mafaira zvadzimwa, freed
cards-loading-description: WeKan loads bhodhi makadhi automatically: a big bhodhi (over the size threshold) loads chete the makadhi currently visible (infinite scroll) plus a live count, so it stays fast uye uses zvishoma memory uye bandwidth, while smaller mabhodhi load every kadhi for the simplest, fully featured experience. There iri nothing ku configure. Operators anogona still force a mode ne the CARDS_LOADING (zvose/lazy/auto) uye CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy kadhi zviri kutakura iri experimental: kadhi counters uye WIP limits vari accurate, but the Calendar/Table/Gantt views uye multi-select reflect chete the makadhi loaded so far. Reload vhura mabhodhi mushure changing this.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: When yakabatidzwa, zvose links (both markdown links like [chiratidzo](url) uye raw HTML <a href> tags) vari always shown as plain, non-clickable mashoko mu every rich mashoko ndima (bhodhi uye kadhi titles, descriptions, zvirevo, checklists, etc.). This prevents misleading clickable links. yakajairwa iri off, so links stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Always ratidza zvose code as plain mashoko
always-show-code-as-text-description: When yakabatidzwa, rich mashoko iri never rendered as markdown kana HTML: the entire source iri always shown as plain mashoko mu every rich mashoko ndima (bhodhi uye kadhi titles, descriptions, zvirevo, checklists, etc.). This reveals hidden content — HTML zvirevo (<!-- -->), the target ye markdown links, JavaScript uye chero zvimwe code — so zvose code iri always visible, kwete clickable, uye kwete running. yakajairwa iri off, so markdown iri rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: When yakabatidzwa, zvose pinza features vari turned off: importing a bhodhi kubva WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea uye Forgejo, as well as cloning a bhodhi. The pinza menyu sarudzo vari hidden uye the sevha rejects chero pinza request. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-all-export-description: When yakabatidzwa, zvose tumira kunze features vari turned off: exporting a bhodhi as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kana ku NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, uye single-chinamatidzwa tumira kunze. The tumira kunze menyu sarudzo vari hidden uye the sevha rejects chero tumira kunze request. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-import-avatars-description: When yakabatidzwa, avatars (mushandisi profile pictures) vari never zvapinzwa. This covers WeKan JSON pinza, Trello pinza, uye avatar sync kubva external identity providers pa login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names uye zvimwe data vari still zvapinzwa; chete avatars vari skipped. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-export-avatars-description: When yakabatidzwa, avatars (mushandisi profile pictures) vari never included when exporting a bhodhi (WeKan JSON uye CSV tumira kunze). Usernames uye zvimwe data vari still exported; chete avatars vari omitted. yakajairwa iri off.
anonymize-import-users-description: When yakabatidzwa, importing a WeKan JSON bhodhi replaces every zvapinzwa user's zita remushandisi, full zita uye initials ne counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, uye rewrites @zita remushandisi mentions (uye the requested-by / assigned-by ndima) inside zvapinzwa kadhi uye chirevo content. kwete real mushandisi identity kubva the source bhodhi iri stored. The word "mushandisi" follows the mutauro ye the person importing. yakajairwa iri off.
anonymize-export-users-description: When yakabatidzwa, exporting a bhodhi replaces every exported user's zita remushandisi, full zita uye initials ne counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, uye rewrites @zita remushandisi mentions (uye the requested-by / assigned-by ndima) inside kadhi uye chirevo content. The exported faira carries kwete real mushandisi identity. The word "mushandisi" follows the mutauro ye the person exporting. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-activities-description: When yakabatidzwa, activity-feed entries vari never recorded uye never shown anywhere (bhodhi sidebar uye kadhi chiitiko tab). kwete nhoroondo ye who did what iri kept. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-notifications-description: When yakabatidzwa, WeKan never sends watch zviziviso (in-app, email kana zvimwe services) for chero chiitiko. Activities anogona still iva recorded (unless also yakadzimwa above); chete the zviziviso vari suppressed. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-watch-description: When yakabatidzwa, the watch feature iri turned off — vashandisi haagoni subscribe ku mabhodhi, rondedzero kana makadhi ku receive zviziviso, uye chero attempt ku chinja a watch level iri rejected. yakajairwa iri off.
backup-description: Back up Attachments, Avatars uye/kana Data (zvose text-based collections that vari kwete attachments kana avatars). The .zip iri streamed directly ku the zvasarudzwa storage — kwete temporary faira — as backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, containing YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars uye /data. Cloud storages (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) use the credentials configured mu their storage tabs.
backup-scope-description: The whole instance, kana one sangano. An sangano's backup contains its mabhodhi uye everything pa them, including the attachments ye those mabhodhi — but kwete mushandisi accounts uye kwete instance marongero, because those vari shared na every sangano. Restoring an sangano's backup chete ever writes ku mabhodhi that sangano owns.
theme-override-all-tenants: Override that applies ku zvose tenants
backup-restore-select-first: sarudza a backup kubva the rondedzero yekutanga.
backup-restore-confirm: dzorera the zvasarudzwa backup? Attachments/avatars vari written ku the filesystem uye data ku the database according ku the chosen mode.
gcs-key-filename-description: Optional: path ku a service akaundi JSON key faira pa the sevha.
gcs-credentials-description: Optional: paste the service akaundi JSON key. Leave blank ku use the key faira kana yakajairwa credentials.
gcs-permissions-note: Give WeKan's service akaundi read/write access ku the bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → yako bucket → mvumo → Grant access. mu "itsva principals", paste the service akaundi email — the "client_email" ukoshi kubva yako JSON key — then sarudza the role "Storage Object mukuru" uye chengeta.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Leave blank ku keep the yazvino ukoshi.
azure-account-name-description: The zita ye yako Azure Storage akaundi.
azure-container-description: The blob container ku store mafaira mu.
gcs-bucket-description: The zita ye the Cloud Storage bucket ku store mafaira mu.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: leave blank (uses the region endpoint). S3-compatible: the Endpoint URL kubva yako MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces console.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → yako bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → yako bucket zita (kana gadzira bucket → Bucket zita).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → vashandisi → yako mushandisi → chengetedzo credentials → Access keys → gadzira access key → sarudza use case 'application running outside AWS' → gadzira access key. Shown as 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: zvimwe chete screen as the Access key ID; 'Secret access key' iri shown chete once when the key iri zvagadzirwa — kopa it then (kana dhaunirodha .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → zita shown pa the top (also under chengetedzo + networking → Access keys → Storage akaundi zita).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → chengetedzo + networking → Access keys → key1 → ratidza → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → chengetedzo + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → ratidza.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → Data storage → Containers → yako container (kana + Container ku gadzira one).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → project selector pa the top → yako project's ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → yako bucket zita (kana gadzira ku make one).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Path pa the WeKan sevha ku the downloaded service akaundi JSON key faira (zvagadzirwa below). Use this kana paste the JSON into the ndima below.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & mukuru → Service accounts → yako service akaundi → Keys → wedzera key → gadzira itsva key → JSON → gadzira (downloads the faira). Paste its contents here, kana chengeta the faira uye set its path above.

attachment-move-storage-gcs: fambisa chinamatidzwa ku Google Cloud Storage

comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Performs comprehensive checks uye fixes for bhodhi data integrity, including rondedzero ordering, kadhi positions, uye mukoto structure.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Safely deletes empty duplicate rondedzero. chete removes rondedzero that have kwete makadhi uye have another rondedzero ne the zvimwe chete musoro that contains makadhi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Finds uye restores makadhi uye rondedzero ne missing swimlaneId kana listId. Creates a 'Lost makadhi' mukoto ku make zvose lost items visible zvakare.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Restores zvose zvakachengetwa swimlanes, rondedzero, uye makadhi. Automatically fixes chero missing swimlaneId kana listId ku make items visible.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Detects uye repairs missing kana corrupted rondedzero mu the bhodhi structure.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Updates avatar URLs for bhodhi nhengo ku use the correct storage backend uye fixes broken avatar references.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Updates zvose faira chinamatidzwa URLs pa bhodhi iri ku use the correct storage backend uye fixes broken faira references.
migrations-admin-only: chete bhodhi administrators anogona run migrations
migrations-description: Run data integrity checks uye repairs for bhodhi iri. Each migration anogona iva executed individually.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: This will perform a comprehensive migration ku check uye fix bhodhi data integrity. This anogona take a few moments. Continue?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: This will yekutanga convert chero shared rondedzero ku per-mukoto rondedzero, then dzima empty rondedzero that have a duplicate rondedzero ne the zvimwe chete musoro containing makadhi. chete truly redundant empty rondedzero will iva zvabviswa. Continue?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: This will gadzira a 'Lost makadhi' mukoto uye dzorera zvose makadhi uye rondedzero ne missing swimlaneId kana listId. This chete affects non-archived items. Continue?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: This will dzorera zvose zvakachengetwa swimlanes, rondedzero, uye makadhi, making them visible zvakare. chero items ne missing IDs will iva automatically fixed. This haagoni iva easily undone. Continue?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: This will detect uye repair missing kana corrupted rondedzero mu the bhodhi structure. Continue?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: This will gadziridza avatar URLs for bhodhi nhengo ku use the correct storage backend. Continue?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: This will gadziridza zvose faira chinamatidzwa URLs pa bhodhi iri ku use the correct storage backend. Continue?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: kwete lost swimlanes, rondedzero, kana makadhi ku dzorera
migration-progress-note: ndapota mira while we migrate yako bhodhi ku the latest structure...
conversion-info-text: This conversion iri performed once per bhodhi uye improves performance. unogona continue using the bhodhi normally.
converting-board-description: Converting bhodhi structure for improved functionality. This anogona take a few moments.
migration-batch-size-description: Number ye attachments ku process mu each batch (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Mashoko echiShona: Pause migration when CPU usage exceeds this percentage (10-90)
migration-info-text: Database migrations vari performed once uye improve sisitimu performance. The process continues mu the kumashure even if you vhara yako browser.
migration-warning-text: Please do kwete vhara yako browser during migration. The process will continue mu the kumashure but anogona take longer ku pedzisa.
monitoring-export-failed: Failed ku tumira kunze monitoring data

problems-summary-help: Check the problem areas you have reviewed, then click Acknowledge ku dzorera their new-problem count.
problems-in-progress-help: These migrations kana repairs vari running now. Logins anogona iva slow, kana ratidza "anofanira iva logged mu" kana a "zviri kutakura, ndapota mira" spinner, until they finish uye CPU drops.
problems-none-in-progress: kwete migrations kana repairs vari mu progress.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Repaired __fixed__ kadhi(s). __unfixable__ kadhi(s) have kwete bhodhi uye haagoni iva repaired automatically.
